name: consort
description: Kept companions, for anybody — not just one authored pair. A consort is any NPC with flags.consort=true and flags.devoted_to=<handle>, and who they ARE comes from flags.consort_archetype: a registry of 12 sub-personalities (Strategist, Romantic, Feral, Devout, Brat, Ghost, Comedian, Scholar, Cold One, Performer, Veteran, Grateful), each with its own full set of devotion/arousal/shy/worried/pour/absence/talk/entrance pools. Nothing resolves a voice by NAME any more, so a consort can carry a generated name and still speak in character. Both sexes; every line is written with pronoun tokens resolved per consort. Physicality is generated from an appearance SEED — build, height, hair, eyes, skin, mouth, grooming, scent, voice, age, optional scars and chrome — so two consorts of the same archetype still read as different people. ORDERING: the MIS-gated B.L.I.S.S. tablet app (Bonded Live-In Intimacy Subscription Service) shows a seeded six-slot catalogue, rerollable on a 10-minute cooldown, listing every physical characteristic plus how the placement describes THEMSELVES rather than a clinical label; a placement is delivered to any private space you hold (apartment you control, premises you own, or a zone flagged private_billet_owner) for a significant daily retainer, tiered by archetype/build rarity and discounted the longer they stay. Billing runs on environment.dayRollover, drafted bank then pocket; two consecutive misses and the Syndicate collects them. Consorts are LIVE-ONLY NPCs spawned from the player_consorts ledger — never `npcs` rows, so a roster can never export as world content. PAIRINGS are the rare high end: two archetypes placed and released together, priced at a premium, and the only consorts that run two-hander scenes with each other (Cyd's Roxy & Jolie are now simply the first pairing). Two consorts in the same room who are BOTH aroused past MUTUAL_AT will turn to each other rather than the keeper — its own branch ahead of the keeper acts on a lower threshold, three pools by sex (ff/mm/mixed, the mixed thread written with the woman as A and the cast reordered to match), paired or not, and indifferent to the keeper's sex since he isn't in it (he only watches, and gains from it). Consorts who are NOT a pairing also react to each other in a basic co-presence register — sizing each other up, settling the pecking order — keyed by BOTH sexes (speaker first: ff/fm/mf/mm), so each direction is different writing rather than a mirror; it only plays when the room is private, and never assumes the keeper's sex. A 15s tick reads the live room: alone with their keeper, arousal builds and they undress themselves (MIS-gated), murmur devotion, and — peaked, MIS on — perform their signature acts (KEEPER_ACTS is a full [keeper sex][consort sex] matrix — the keeper is a PLAYER and players are male or female, so the old maleOnly flag that gave female players no acts at all is gone; act keys are the role not the anatomy (oral/ride/hand) and the keeper sex selects which half of the matrix plays. A mixed-sex pairing degrades to a solo scene rather than play mismatched prose); a stranger cools them off and turns them shy; a keeper who comes home hurt stops the seduction entirely. They also react to how long you've been gone, in two bands. Beckoned out of their room they live a life keyed to the area they're in (areaProfile off zone flags). `beckon`/`dismiss` are keeper-only; `pour` and the name-prefixed direct commands work for whoever they answer to. A consort also ASKS their keeper things and waits on the reply: questions.js holds a pool of conversations (are you staying tonight, what did you actually do out there today, do you do the arithmetic on what I cost you), the keeper answers with `say`, and the reply is classified into a branch they react to specifically — an unreadable reply is a written dodge, silence is a written timeout, and a branch can be worth arousal in either direction. Not MIS-gated and gated below AROUSED_AT: it is the clothed half of the relationship. Half the pool is DYNAMIC — questions they only ask because of something they can see (the hour, the wounds you walked in with, the stars on you, the weather, what's left in the account, how long they've been kept), built from live memory with no query and quoting the real numbers back at you, with the context snapshotted at ask time so the reaction quotes what was asked about. The B.L.I.S.S. register is now shelved by sex and built to an EVEN SPLIT by plan rather than a coin per slot, pairings are rolled once per register (16%) and capped at one, and a refresh costs a GAME DAY rather than ten minutes — the cooldown is the only scarcity mechanism and at ten minutes it wasn't one. A listing leads with TEMPERAMENT (four traits, warmth/wants and a written downside for every one of the twelve) and three real lines from the pools they'll actually speak from, then the appearance card, then an itemised explicit specification generated from the same seed — which never reaches describeAppearance(), so a stranger examining a consort in a room is never shown it. The whole tick is deliberately unhurried — spoken beats minutes apart, scenes on a 15-minute room cooldown, arousal taking several minutes of undisturbed company to peak.
